PRS codec: unmodified prskit by Kyle Mayer, MIT licensed.
Source: https://github.com/reshaped/sonic-adventure/tree/25a3d3154dbe657325e97dbe8c5291086f6af5c0/tools/prskit
Files prskit.c and prskit.h are copied byte-for-byte from that pinned revision.
LICENSE.txt preserves the upstream LICENSE bytes and must accompany distribution.
This codec is generic compression code; no game data, assets or SDK bodies are
included here. Its explicit MIT permission is separate from the unresolved
redistribution permission for the upstream game's complete source.
